==Summary==

{{pov|[[Pevara Tazanovni]]}}

Pevara is meeting with [[Tarna Feir]] in her rooms with [[Pedra]] serving tea. Tarna is now the [[Keeper of the Chronicles]], replacing [[Alviarin Freidhen]] after her month long absence. Tarna recounts how she encountered a recruiting party of [[Asha'man]] when she was returning from [[Salidar]] to the [[The White Tower|White Tower]]. After pondering the situation for a long time she has concluded that [[Aes Sedai]] must take the Asha'man as Warders so they can be controlled, whether they could be [[Severing|gentled]] afterwards or not. Pevara shows Tarna a message she received from [[Cairhien]], originally sent by [[Toveine Gazal]]. She suggests it changes the whole world.
